items.text: Change the stage from Adopted to In force
items.reason: The entry into force date of 10 November 2026 has passed, moving the act to stage 3 (In force).

items.text: New status text: “In force. Entered into force on 10 November 2026. The revised ESRS apply from financial year 2027, while the voluntary reporting standard has been in force since 24 September 2026.”
items.reason: Update status text now that the 10 November 2026 entry into force date has passed.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims Commission confirms withdrawal of the proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed in November 2026 that it is scrapping and withdrawing the proposed Green Claims Directive.

items.text: New status text: “Scrapped by the European Commission in November 2026 following the cancellation of trilogue negotiations in 2025.”
items.reason: The Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal of the proposal in early November 2026.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-12: “EU ETS provisional agreement reached on boosting free carbon allowances for industry”
items.reason: The Council and European Parliament reached a provisional agreement on 12 November 2026 to boost free carbon allowances for energy-intensive industries.
